title: Loggit
body:
## One of Minecraft's largest problems is it's lack of a full, complete timer. We don't _really_ need words to explain what this mod does, so here's a demo: ![After the loading screen, the screen fades into a black background with the words "You've played for:" typing out in white on a black background. Then underneath, a series of numbers in green switch around before finally arriving at your total playtime. Then, the word "hours" types out at the bottom, the same way as the intital text for you've played for. Then, the screen fades into the normal minecraft home screen. The total time is ~5 seconds.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BaguetteLauncher31/Loggit-assets/main/Loggit%20Demo.gif) My sincere apologies for the lack of visual quality in the above gif, but you understand the point. ## Wanted to add those couple thousand hours you already had? We have a menu for that! Just click the green "Loggit" in the bottom left corner! ![Image of the main page with an arrow showing where to click to open the Loggit menu.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e87f33c2d8603bffc53a6cded0a3051d29c3aa73_0.webp) ^^ That green text ## Commonly asked questions:
Q: How do I transfer times between versions?
A: Just take a look at the in game menu on the older version, and copy paste in the old values into the in game menu on the newer version.
Q: How long is the intro?
A: ~ 4-5 seconds.
Q: Can I use this mod in my modpack?
A: Yeah! *As long as it's on Modrinth, however.
Q: For those who are unable to view the gif, here is alt text:
A: After the loading screen, the screen fades into a black background with the words "You've played for:" typing out in white on a black background. Then underneath, a series of numbers in green switch around before finally arriving at your total playtime. Then, the word "hours" types out at the bottom, the same way as the intital text for you've played for. Then, the screen fades into the normal minecraft home screen. The total time is ~5 seconds.
